newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Burlington Northern buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Burlington Northern buy reiterated.

text.p: - Gruntal Investment Research analyst Steve Lewins said Thursday the firm reiterated its buy rating on Burlington Northern Santa Fe Corp.
- Lewins said his price target for the stock is $100 a share.
- Lewins said nothing came up in a meeting with analysts Wednesday to indicate the rail company is not making the progress promised when Burlington Northern merged with Santa Fe Pacific last year.
- The full integration of Santa Fe and Burlington will take time, Lewins said, but the company and Union Pacific Corp remain Gruntal's rail selections of choice.
- Burlington Northern stock was up 7/8 at 87-7/8.
